bioconda.name: dipper
bioconda.summary: DIPPER: An ultrafast tool for phylogenetic tree reconstruction.
bioconda.description: DIPPER (DIstance-based Phylogenetic PlacER) is a tool designed for ultrafast and ultralarge phylogenetic tree reconstruction on GPUs. It is capable of reconstructing a phylogenetic tree with 10 million taxa, with a minimal memory footprint.
